part.text:
Fixed. The regression from PR #20895 in fastlane/lib/fastlane/fast_file.rb:410 skipped the git checkout in the non-caching path whenever `version` was nil, so the Fastfile was never checked out of the freshly cloned repo.

The fix changes the condition from `!version.nil? && current_tag != version` to `version.nil? || current_tag != version`, so the checkout runs when no version is specified (restoring the pre-regression default behavior) or when the checked-out tag doesn't match the requested one.

All 13 `import_from_git_spec.rb` examples pass, including the previously failing "works when no cache is provided", plus the related `import_spec.rb` tests.
